honest_caveats: The statistical test is a from-scratch Python re-implementation of the paper's described recipe (arcsin-sqrt proportions + channel fixed effect, gRNA vs NonTarget2 contrast) -- not a call into the paper's own R package (speckle::propeller.ttest). Direction and order of magnitude match; exact p-values/FDR do not.

The paper's most profound Foxg1 effect (L6-CT sub-cluster 3, FDR<0.028, 1.8-24.4-fold) is at a finer clustering resolution than the object's own CellType column exposes, and was not independently re-clustered here.

Requires ~4 GB of local download (GSE249416_Perturb_all.qs.gz + GSE249416_Perturb_sg.qs.gz) and an R environment with qs + SeuratObject, which are not on CRAN's current binary track for this R version -- see OPERATIONS.md for the exact bootstrap (including a required stringfish downgrade).
